contents.Text: Select multiple tables to combine them in the viewport/(Select values).
Selected tables are shown in a lighter purple.
[[[strong:Tip:]]] To select a range, [[[strong:SHIFT + LEFT-CLICK]]] the first table, scroll down, then [[[strong:SHIFT + LEFT-CLICK]]] the last table to select every table in between.
Shows the status of the [[[strong:Multi-Table Mode]]] and the stats of the selected tables.

rows: The total amount of rows in the viewport/(Select values)
Some of the table names that are combined

contents.Text: [[[strong:Tip:]]] You can use the [[[strong:Multi-Table Mode]]] toggle/icon to return to [[[strong:single-table]]] mode.
In the [[[strong:Name]]] column, each row shows the table it is from in blue, followed by the name of the song in white.
